Good food and exceptional service
Dec 2025 • Couples
We had an absolutely wonderful experience at this restaurant. The food was delicious, beautifully presented, and full of flavour, and the ambience made the evening feel warm, elegant, and truly special.

A very special mention goes to their F&B Manager, Helen, who went above and beyond to make our anniversary unforgettable. From arranging the flowers and cake to setting up a beautiful decoration, every detail was taken care of with so much thought and care. She is the perfect example of how someone should be in the hospitality business—professional, thoughtful, and truly passionate about creating memorable experiences.

Also a big thank you to Mira, our server, who took excellent care of our table throughout the evening. She was attentive, friendly, and made sure everything was perfect for us.

Highly recommend this place—not just for the great food and ambience, but for the exceptional service that makes every moment feel special.

Wonderful atmosphere, attentive staff, delicious food
Jul 2025 • Couples
Had dinner here when we stayed at Mercure Ba Na Hills. The restaurant had an elegant, peaceful and serene atmosphere and ambiance. 

Our waitress, Farah, was very attentive and lovely. She checked that everything was good for us, very professional and really nice. After several weeks of travelling in Laos and Vietnam, we were pinning for some home food, We couldn’t go past the Australian Striploin beef on their menu. It was cooked to perfection, (medium rare) and the red wine just is simply delicious. 

This was a step up and pleasant change from Mercure’s other (buffet) dining option at Le Crique.

I left hungry
Apr 2025 • Solo
You really do need to order 3 courses when dining here for dinner because the portions are very small. The mains menu is a bit deceptive because the photos and descriptions make the meals sound more generous. I had the signature duck dish, which was fine, but I wish I’d realised that the dab of black to the right was the truffle! I had finished before I noticed it! 

I’d skip here and go to the noodle place, room service, or bbq if you’re staying at the hotel and not up for a buffet.
Written April 20, 2025
